preconditions.expression: isinstance(input_strings, list) and len(input_strings) == 2 and all(isinstance(s, str) for s in input_strings)
preconditions.description: The input is a list containing exactly two strings.

postconditions.expression: len(output.split()) == max(len(s) for s in input_strings)
postconditions.description: The number of spaces in the output string is equal to the length of the longer input string.

postconditions.expression: all(c == ' ' or isinstance(c, str) for row in zip(*input_strings) for c in row) and all(c == ' ' or isinstance(c, str) for c in output)
postconditions.description: Each character in the output string is either a space or a string character, and there are no partial spaces at the end of the output.

postconditions.expression: all(c1 == c2 or c1 == ' ' or c2 == ' ' for c1, c2 in zip(output, ' '.join(input_strings)))
postconditions.description: Each character in the output string corresponds to a character in the input strings, with spaces filling in for the shorter string.
